result.reason: The redline gives Company a 30-day convenience right, but it does not expressly require a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees and instead permits recovery of non-cancellable expenses. It also retains the original provision allowing either party—including Vendor—to terminate on 15 days’ notice whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding, which does not meet either the preferred or fallback restriction on Vendor termination. Retaining that overlapping sentence creates inconsistent notice periods and unnecessary ambiguity.
